name: Mock Bank Transaction
description: Search for member 12345, navigate to their dashboard, initiate a savings transaction of 500, reach the confirmation page, extract the full text of the paragraph that starts with 'Successfully processed' into a variable named 'transaction_receipt', and then immediately output an action of wait with a value of DONE.

steps.thought: I need to search for member 12345. I can see a textbox with placeholder 'Enter ID...' where I should enter the member ID.
The member ID 12345 has already been entered into the textbox. Now I need to click the 'Search Database' button to proceed with searching for this member.
I am now on the dashboard for member 12345 (Alice Smith). I can see the Savings account with a 'Transact' link. I need to click on this link to initiate a savings transaction of 500.

I am now on the New Transaction page for member 12345. The Savings account type is already selected in the combobox. I need to enter the amount of 500 into the spinbutton field to proceed with the savings transaction.

The savings transaction page is now properly filled with the amount of 500 and the Savings account type is selected. I need to click the 'Submit Transaction' button to proceed to the confirmation page where I can extract the transaction receipt text.

The transaction has been successfully processed. I can see the paragraph that starts with 'Successfully processed' which contains '$500 for savings account.' I need to extract the full text of this paragraph into the variable 'transaction_receipt'. The paragraph text is: 'Successfully processed $500 for savings account.'

I have successfully completed all the required steps: searched for member 12345, navigated to their dashboard, initiated a savings transaction of 500, reached the confirmation page, and extracted the transaction receipt text into the 'transaction_receipt' variable. The goal is now complete.
